name: PlanetStream
summary: PLANETSTREAM — The easiest streaming setup ever. Stream VR straight from your Quest. No PC. No OBS. No capture card. Open the app, paste your stream key, go live. WHAT IT DOES: Stream any Quest game to YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, and more — all at once through Restream (one RTMP feed). Voice changer (Normal, Deep, Chipmunk, Robot, Cyber). Real-time closed captions, generated on-device from your mic (stream-only, never in your headset). Mixed-reality facecam: your phone camera cuts you out (no green screen) and
